title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 2,951–3,000 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 機器人學；機器人工程技術

examples.en: Taiwan's precision machinery sector is a global powerhouse in industrial robotics.
examples.zh: 台灣精密機械產業在全球工業機器人技術領域位居舉足輕重的龍頭地位。

examples.en: High school students built programmable competing bots in the national robotics competition.
examples.zh: 高中學生在全國青少年機器人競技大賽中，親手打造出具備高靈敏程式控制的競技對戰機器人。

examples.en: Breakthroughs in medical robotics enable surgeons to perform minimally invasive procedures with microscopic accuracy.
examples.zh: 醫療機器人技術的革命性突破，讓外科醫生能夠以顯微鏡級別的微觀精準度執行超微創外科手術。

words.definition: 機械手臂；機器人關節手臂

examples.en: High-speed robotic arms assemble delicate microchips with sub-millimeter precision.
examples.zh: 高速精密機械手臂以次毫米級的極致精準度快速組裝精密半導體晶片。

examples.en: The automobile manufacturing factory deployed hundreds of multi-axis robotic arms for spot welding.
examples.zh: 現代化汽車製造組裝大廠在生產線上全面鋪設了數百台多軸機械手臂，進行全自動雷射點焊。

examples.en: The robotic arm smoothly grabbed the fragile test tube without spilling a single drop of reagent.
examples.zh: 機械手臂極其平穩流暢地夾取抓握住薄壁玻璃試管，全程絲毫未濺出半滴化學檢測試劑。

examples.en: Advanced humanoid robots are designed to assist elderly residents at home.
examples.zh: 先進的高階人形機器人專為在家中照護並陪伴銀髮長者而精心研發。

examples.en: The technology expo showcased a dexterous humanoid robot capable of folding laundry and pouring tea.
examples.zh: 科技博覽會現場隆重亮相了一款動作無比靈巧的人形機器人，能流暢完成折疊衣物與倒茶奉水。

examples.en: Training humanoid robots to walk steadily on uneven rocky terrain remains a formidable engineering challenge.
examples.zh: 訓練人形雙足機器人在崎嶇不平的戶外碎石路面上保持平穩行走，依然是全球頂尖工程界的巨大挑戰。

words.definition: 自主的；自動駕駛的；具自治權的

examples.en: Autonomous shuttle buses are currently being tested on university campuses.
examples.zh: 全自動無人駕駛接駁車目前正於多所大學校園內進行實地載客測試。

examples.en: Research teams deployed an autonomous underwater vehicle to map deep volcanic trenches.
examples.zh: 海洋科研團隊在深海大洋中投放了一艘自主無人潛航器，深入探勘並測繪深海火山海溝地貌。

examples.en: The university department enjoys broad autonomous decision-making authority regarding its curriculum.
examples.zh: 這所大學的學術院系在研擬與調整專業課程教學大綱時，享有極為廣泛且充分的自主決策權。

words.definition: 自動駕駛的；無人自駕的

examples.en: Self-driving electric vehicles navigate complex city intersections using computer vision.
examples.zh: 自動駕駛電動車透過先進的電腦視覺演算法精準穿梭於複雜都會路口。

examples.en: Commuters relax and read books while traveling safely inside certified self-driving taxis.
examples.zh: 通勤族悠閒放鬆地端坐在獲得政府試驗執照的無人自駕計程車內，專心閱讀書籍並安全抵達公司。

examples.en: Public debates continue regarding the legal liability and ethical frameworks surrounding self-driving cars.
examples.zh: 圍繞著無人自駕車發生事故時的民刑法賠償責任歸屬與倫理困境難題，社會各界的公眾討論熱度不減。

words.definition: 自動輔助駕駛；自動駕駛儀

examples.en: Modern electric vehicles feature highway autopilot navigation capabilities.
examples.zh: 現代高階電動車皆配備有國道高速公路自動輔助駕駛與主動巡航系統。

examples.en: Once the commercial airliner cleared turbulent storm clouds, the captain engaged the autopilot.
examples.zh: 當大型噴射客機平穩穿過濃密的強對流積雨雲層後，正機長隨即啟動了飛行自動駕駛儀。

examples.en: Exhausted from caring for newborn twins, the sleep-deprived mother felt like she was moving on autopilot.
examples.zh: 因日夜照護剛出生的雙胞胎新生兒而嚴重睡眠不足，這位疲憊不堪的母親整天宛如行屍走肉般開啟自動導航模式。

examples.en: Solid-state LiDAR emits invisible laser pulses to map 3D surroundings in real time.
examples.zh: 固態光學雷達（LiDAR）發射不可見雷射脈衝以即時建構三維周遭環境圖。

examples.en: Autonomous delivery vehicles rely on rooftop LiDAR sensors to detect pedestrians in low-light alleyways.
examples.zh: 全自動無人配送小車高度依賴車頂搭載的光學雷達感測器，在昏暗狹窄的市區巷弄中精準識別穿行的行人。

examples.en: Archaeologists used airborne LiDAR scanning to penetrate dense jungle canopies and uncover hidden ruins.
examples.zh: 考古探險團隊善用機載高解析度光學雷達空拍掃描，穿透茂密的熱帶原始雨林樹冠層，震撼發現了失落千年的古文明遺跡。

examples.en: Millimeter-wave radar detects distant approaching obstacles during rainstorms.
examples.zh: 毫米波雷達能在暴風雨濃霧等惡劣天候下精準探測遠方逼近的障礙物。

examples.en: Maritime navigation radar alerts ship captains to nearby fishing trawlers in dense sea fog.
examples.zh: 航海船舶專用導航雷達能在茫茫濃霧中第一時間向船長發出預警，精確提示周遭靠近的小型近海拖網漁船。

examples.en: The brilliant new indie video game flew under the radar until a famous gaming streamer recommended it.
examples.zh: 這款極具創意的獨立電玩小作起初完全未引起各界關注（低調不為人知），直到一位頂級遊戲實況主熱情推薦才一夕爆紅。

examples.en: Agricultural drones spray organic fertilizers efficiently over terraced hills.
examples.zh: 農業專用無人機在依山而建的梯田茶園上方高效噴灑天然有機液體肥料。

examples.en: Search and rescue squads deployed thermal imaging drones to locate lost hikers in deep ravines.
examples.zh: 搜救大隊在險峻深山峽谷中緊急升空搭載紅外線熱成像鏡頭的無人機，全力搜尋失聯受困的登山客。

examples.en: Package delivery drones are being tested to transport emergency medications to isolated mountain clinics.
examples.zh: 各國物流先驅正緊鑼密鼓測試利用小型無人機，將救命急需血清藥品極速空運直達偏遠高山巡迴醫療站。

words.definition: 無人機群飛；無人機燈光秀

examples.en: Hundreds of synchronized drones formed Taiwan island shapes in the night sky.
examples.zh: 數百架群飛無人機在夜空中以精密編隊排成了璀璨耀眼的台灣島形狀。

examples.en: Military strategists study how autonomous drone swarm tactics can overwhelm traditional air defense radar.
examples.zh: 軍事戰略家深入鑽研全自動蜂群無人機群協同作戰戰術，如何能瞬間飽和並壓制傳統的防空防衛雷達網。

examples.en: Spectacular drone swarm light shows have become an eco-friendly modern alternative to traditional fireworks.
examples.zh: 氣勢磅礴、流光溢彩的無人機群飛燈光秀，近年已躍升成為全面取代傳統高污染節慶煙火的綠色環保新寵。

words.definition: 遠端遙控操作；遠距手術操控

examples.en: Surgeons used 5G low-latency teleoperation to perform remote operations.
examples.zh: 外科名醫透過 5G 超低延遲遠端遙控操作為偏鄉離島病患施行遠距手術。

examples.en: Hazardous nuclear waste cleanup requires heavy machinery controlled via real-time teleoperation.
examples.zh: 處理高度危險的有毒核廢料清理作業時，必須全面仰賴操作員在數公里外的安全主控室透過遠端操控重型工程機具。

examples.en: Teleoperation allows remote human supervisors to intervene instantly if an autonomous vehicle encounters an edge case.
examples.zh: 完善的遠端遙控操作接管系統，能讓後台安全監控人員在自駕車遭遇罕見極限路況時第一時間無縫介入接管方向盤。

examples.en: AGVs transport heavy pallet loads smoothly throughout automated fulfillment warehouses.
examples.zh: 無人搬運車（AGV）在全自動化物流倉儲內平穩穿梭搬運大重量棧板貨物。

examples.en: Magnetic tape stuck to the concrete floor guides the factory AGV along its fixed assembly path.
examples.zh: 牢固黏貼於工廠水泥地板上的磁條導引軌道，精準指引著 AGV 搬運車沿著既定的工序流水線平穩行駛。

examples.en: Deploying AGVs eliminates repetitive physical strain for warehouse workers, drastically lowering injury rates.
examples.zh: 在智慧大倉內大規模導入無人搬運車，徹底消除了倉管基層人員繁重重複的搬運勞損，大幅壓低了工傷職災率。

words.definition: 自主移動機器人 (Autonomous Mobile Robot)

examples.en: Unlike traditional AGVs, flexible AMRs dynamically navigate around obstacles.
examples.zh: 與傳統磁軌 AGV 不同，高靈活度的 AMR 具備自主動態繞行避障的強大功能。

examples.en: AMRs use onboard cameras and SLAM mapping to build layouts of bustling hospital wards.
examples.zh: 自主移動機器人（AMR）善用機載視覺攝影機與 SLAM 即時建圖技術，能在人流熙攘的醫院病房走廊靈活穿行。

examples.en: Logistics managers prefer AMRs because they do not require expensive modifications to factory floors.
examples.zh: 現代物流主管極其推崇 AMR 機器人，因為引進它完全無須大費周章砸重金改造鋪設昂貴的實體地面導航軌道。

examples.en: The smart logistics warehouse operates round the clock with robotic loaders.
examples.zh: 現代化智慧物流大倉在機器人堆高機的協同作業下實現全天候二十四小時運轉。

examples.en: The old waterfront warehouse was transformed into a hip creative art exhibition gallery.
examples.zh: 這棟座落於老舊港區碼頭邊的紅磚百年老倉庫，被活化改造成為一處極具文青氣息的當代前衛藝術展覽聚落。

examples.en: Automated inventory tracking software ensures that the warehouse never runs out of critical spare parts.
examples.zh: 智慧化全自動庫存管理追蹤軟體，確保了倉儲總部在任何關鍵時刻皆絕不會出現核心維修零組件斷貨缺貨的危機。

examples.en: High-speed sortation cross-belt systems sort 30,000 packages every single hour.
examples.zh: 高速交叉帶自動分揀系統每小時可精準分揀高達三萬件各大超商網購包裹。

examples.en: Barcode scanners integrated into the sortation conveyor direct parcels to their designated city postal bins.
examples.zh: 與分揀輸送帶緊密整合的高速條碼掃描相機，能精準將飛馳而過的外送包裹分流彈射至對應的各縣市郵遞格位。

examples.en: Investing in automated sortation machinery reduced order processing bottlenecks ahead of the Double 11 shopping festival.
examples.zh: 大手筆投資引進全自動高速分揀機械流水線，成功在一年一度的雙十一電商購物狂歡節前夕徹底消弭了出貨卡關瓶頸。

examples.en: Luggage rolls smoothly from airplane cargo holds onto the airport conveyor belt.
examples.zh: 託運行李自飛機貨艙平穩卸下並直接送上航廈行李輸送帶轉盤供旅客提領。

examples.en: Diners seated around the revolving sushi counter pick up fresh sashimi plates from the moving conveyor belt.
examples.zh: 環繞著旋轉壽司吧檯而坐的老饕食客，隨心所欲從眼前緩緩流轉的食材傳送帶上取下剛捏好的新鮮生魚片握壽司。

examples.en: Technicians inspect goods along the factory conveyor belt to catch cosmetic flaws before packaging.
examples.zh: 品管檢驗技師駐守在工廠傳送帶兩側，在商品進入裝盒打包工序之前，全神貫注剔除任何有微小外觀瑕疵的半成品。

examples.en: Taipei was ranked among global top ten smartest cities for digital governance.
examples.zh: 台北市憑藉卓越的數位治理與智慧市民服務名列全球前十大智慧城市。

examples.en: Key indicators of a thriving smart city include real-time public transit tracking, digital citizen services, and green energy.
examples.zh: 衡量一座繁榮發展之智慧城市的關鍵核心指標，涵蓋即時公車動態追蹤、一站式數位便民服務以及普及的潔淨綠能。

examples.en: Singapore is widely recognized as a pioneering model for international smart city development.
examples.zh: 新加坡在善用數據科技治理城市方面的卓越開創性實踐，被各國公認為當代全球智慧城市規劃建設的典範標竿。

examples.en: Transparent data-driven urban governance optimizes city budget allocations.
examples.zh: 以數據為導向的透明市政都市治理能最大程度精準優化市府預算資源分配。

examples.en: Sound corporate governance establishes clear ethical guidelines and prevents conflicts of interest among board directors.
examples.zh: 健全卓越的企業公司治理架構能確立清晰嚴明的商業道德準則，並徹底防杜董事會成員之間發生任何利益衝突。

examples.en: Citizens demand democratic accountability and participatory governance at all levels of public administration.
examples.zh: 現代成熟公民社會強烈要求各級公法人行政機關，在施政過程中必須切實落實民主監督制衡與全民參與式治理。

examples.en: Smart traffic lights adjust green light duration dynamically based on queue length.
examples.zh: 智慧動態號誌紅綠燈能根據路口車流排隊長度即時微調綠燈秒數以疏解車潮。

examples.en: AI-powered smart traffic lights prioritize approaching fire engines and ambulances automatically.
examples.zh: 導入人工智慧視覺辨識的智慧交通號誌，能主動感應並全自動為緊急馳援的消防車與救護車開啟綠燈優先通行。

examples.en: Installing smart traffic lights along major commuter boulevards reduced average morning commute times by fifteen percent.
examples.zh: 沿著市區多條主要通勤林蔭大道全線廣設智慧動態號誌燈後，成功將早尖峰市民平均通勤耗時大幅削減了一成五。

examples.en: Expanded metro MRT lines successfully relieved downtown road congestion.
examples.zh: 捷運新路線網絡的不斷延伸與擴建成功大幅緩解了市中心道路交通壅塞。

examples.en: Using a saline nasal spray helps clear up severe sinus congestion during winter colds.
examples.zh: 在冬季罹患重感冒時使用溫和的生理食鹽水噴鼻劑沖洗鼻腔，有助於迅速緩解令人痛苦不堪的鼻竇鼻塞腫脹。

examples.en: Congestion pricing in central London encourages drivers to switch to public transit during peak hours.
examples.zh: 英國倫敦市中心所推行的高額交通壅塞費政策，極為有效地促使廣大車主在早晚尖峰時段果斷改搭大眾運輸工具。

words.definition: 閉路監視攝影機；天眼監視器 (CCTV)

examples.en: High-definition surveillance cameras protect neighborhood security across the city.
examples.zh: 高畫質治安監視錄影機（CCTV）全天候默默守護著全台各社區鄰里的公共安防。

examples.en: Traffic police reviewed surveillance camera footage to determine the exact cause of the intersection collision.
examples.zh: 交通警察透過反覆調閱十字路口高空監視錄影機的超清監視畫面，迅速精準還原並釐清了擦撞事故的真實肇因。

examples.en: Modern surveillance cameras feature night-vision infrared sensors and cloud motion alerts.
examples.zh: 現代化先進居家監控攝影機全面配備了紅外線夜視感應功能，並能在偵測到異常人形移動時秒發雲端警訊。

examples.en: Travelers clear automated e-Gates in seconds using biometric facial recognition.
examples.zh: 旅客在桃園國際機場出入境時只需透過生物特徵人臉辨識即可數秒快速通關。

examples.en: Smartphone users unlock their devices conveniently in the dark using 3D facial recognition sensors.
examples.zh: 智慧型手機用戶即便身處完全漆黑的臥室中，亦能透過 3D 結構光人臉辨識感測器秒速解鎖隨身手機螢幕。

examples.en: Privacy advocates express concerns that unregulated facial recognition technology could be abused for mass tracking.
examples.zh: 個資隱私權倡議團體提出嚴正關切，憂心若缺乏完善法律規制，人臉辨識演算法恐有遭濫用於大規模社會監控之虞。

examples.en: Automated license plate recognition allows ticketless entry into parking garages.
examples.zh: 自動化車牌辨識系統（LPR）讓車主享受免抽停車票卡、自動進出停車場的便利。

examples.en: The young researcher received international recognition for her breakthrough discovery in quantum computing.
examples.zh: 這位年輕的女科學家憑藉其在量子運算領域所取得的原創突破性科研成果，贏得了全球科學界的高度推崇與認可。

examples.en: Voice recognition software converts spoken lectures into written lecture notes with impressive accuracy.
examples.zh: 現代先進的語音辨識演算法能夠將學者在台上發表的學術演講錄音，以令人驚嘆的極高準確率實時轉化為文字速記。

examples.en: The national smart grid integrates solar, wind, and battery storage seamlessly.
examples.zh: 國家智慧電網能將太陽光電、風力發電與大型儲能系統進行無縫智慧調度。

examples.en: When extreme weather threatens the power line, the smart grid automatically reroutes electricity around the damage.
examples.zh: 當極端強烈暴風雨肆虐毀損某處高壓電塔輸電線路時，智慧電網能毫秒級自動繞道切換迴路以保障下游民生供電。

examples.en: Smart grids allow homeowners with solar panels to sell surplus electricity back to the municipal utility company.
examples.zh: 智慧電網具備雙向供電特性，讓家戶屋頂裝有太陽能光電板的尋常百姓能將白晝發出的富餘綠電反向售回給台電公司。

examples.en: Installing a home smart meter allows residents to track hourly power usage online.
examples.zh: 家中安裝智慧電表能讓住戶隨時在手機線上查看每小時即時用電量與電費。

examples.en: The power utility company uses digital smart meters to read consumption remotely without sending technicians to houses.
examples.zh: 國營電力公司全面推廣數位智慧電表，後台電腦遠端即可自動完成抄表作業，徹底淘汰了挨家挨戶人工抄表的傳統模式。

examples.en: Analyzing data from your smart meter helps you identify power-hungry appliances that inflate your electric bill.
examples.zh: 透過智慧手機 App 深度剖析智慧電表回傳的每小時用電大數據，能精準揪出暗中推高您家昂貴夏季電費的吃電怪獸家電。

examples.en: The hospital's emergency generators kicked in within seconds during the power outage.
examples.zh: 醫院內的緊急備用發電機在無預警突發停電發生的數秒之內立即自動啟動供電。

examples.en: The massive earthquake severed high-voltage transmission lines, plunging three million households into a sudden power outage.
examples.zh: 毀滅性強烈大地震震斷了山區超高壓主要輸電線路，瞬間導致全台超過三百萬戶城鄉家庭陷入一片漆黑的突發大停電。

examples.en: Keep emergency flashlights, bottled water, and battery-powered radios handy in case of an unexpected summer power outage.
examples.zh: 平時在家中應當常備充飽電的應急強光手電筒、瓶裝飲用水與吃電池的手搖收音機，以防酷夏無預警停電事故。

examples.en: Data centers maintain diesel backup generators to ensure non-stop server uptime.
examples.zh: 雲端資料中心配備有大型柴油緊急備用發電機，確保伺服器永不停機運作。

examples.en: Campers brought a portable solar-powered generator to charge laptops, drones, and camera batteries outdoors.
examples.zh: 熱愛戶外野營的玩家專程隨車攜帶了一台便攜式戶外太陽能儲能發電機，在深山大自然中為筆電、空拍機與相機隨時充電。

examples.en: The giant hydroelectric dam features twelve massive turbine generators driven by rushing water.
examples.zh: 這座雄偉的高山巨型水力發電水庫大壩內部，整齊排列著十二具由萬頃奔騰水流高速驅動的巨型渦輪水輪發電機組。

words.definition: 基礎建設；公共設施架構

examples.en: High-speed rail and fiber optic networks are crucial national infrastructure.
examples.zh: 台灣高鐵與全島光纖寬頻網路網絡皆為支撐經濟繁榮不可或缺的國家基礎建設。

examples.en: The local government allocated billions to upgrade decaying wastewater and water drainage infrastructure.
examples.zh: 地方政府大手筆編列了數百億專案預算，全力翻新並全面升級市區年久失修的老舊生活污水管網與雨水防洪排澇基建。

examples.en: Expanding electric vehicle charging infrastructure is critical for encouraging widespread EV adoption.
examples.zh: 在全台高速公路服務區與都會停車場廣設公共充電樁基礎設施，是推動全民踴躍換開純電動汽車的最核心關鍵前提。

examples.en: Small businesses embrace cloud digitalization to streamline order processing.
examples.zh: 中小企業與傳統老店積極擁抱雲端數位化轉型以全面簡化接單與出貨流程。

examples.en: Digitalization of hospital medical records allows doctors to access patient health history across clinics instantly.
examples.zh: 全國各大醫院病歷資料庫的全面數位化連線，使主治醫師在跨院看診時能秒速調閱病患過往完整的歷史就診用藥紀錄。

examples.en: The government's digitalization initiative enables citizens to renew passports and pay taxes entirely online.
examples.zh: 政府積極推動的全面數位化便民新政，讓廣大國民足不出戶即可在線上完成護照換發申請與綜合所得稅試算申報。

words.definition: 政府開放資料；公共開放數據

examples.en: Taiwan's Open Data portal provides free real-time transit and air quality datasets.
examples.zh: 台灣政府資料開放平台提供免費的高品質即時大眾運輸動態與空氣品質開放數據。

examples.en: App developers utilized government open data to create popular real-time bus tracking and rainfall alert applications.
examples.zh: 許多民間優秀軟體開發團隊善用政府釋出的開放資料 API，成功打造出多款大受民眾歡迎的即時公車到站與降雨警示 App。

examples.en: Publishing public budget figures as structured open data increases government transparency and discourages corruption.
examples.zh: 將各級政府機關的年度公共預算編列與執行細目以標準化格式向全社會完全開放，能極大化提升政務透明度並防遏貪腐弊端。

examples.en: Responsible digital citizens verify news facts before sharing viral online posts.
examples.zh: 具備高度素養的現代數位公民在社群轉發熱門貼文前皆會嚴謹查證新聞真實性。

examples.en: Teaching schoolchildren how to be safe, respectful digital citizens is a core goal of the modern media literacy curriculum.
examples.zh: 從小教導中小學生如何在浩瀚網路世界中保護個人隱私並成為彼此尊重的優質數位公民，是當代媒體識讀教育的核心主旨。

examples.en: Active digital citizens participate in online public forums to propose and debate new civic policies.
examples.zh: 具備公共意識的熱心數位公民，積極踴躍在政府公共政策網路參與平台上針對各項新政提出富有建設性的公民建言。

words.definition: 數位雙生；數位分身模型

examples.en: Engineers built a 3D digital twin of the city to simulate flood evacuation routes.
examples.zh: 工程專家為整座城市構建了 3D 數位雙生虛擬模型以精準模擬洪澇疏散路線。

examples.en: The semiconductor foundry created a digital twin of its cleanroom to optimize wafer manufacturing yields.
examples.zh: 頂尖晶圓代工龍頭為旗下先進無塵室廠房打造了高擬真數位分身，以極致優化十二吋晶圓的整體量產良率。

examples.en: Operating a real-time digital twin allows technicians to detect invisible machinery vibrations before a factory line breaks.
examples.zh: 運作高精度即時數位雙生系統，能讓工程技師在產線機台發生致命停機故障前，敏銳探測並揪出肉眼難辨的微小異常機械震動。

words.definition: 虛擬模擬；電腦模擬試驗

examples.en: Flight simulation software prepares pilots for extreme crosswind landings safely.
examples.zh: 飛行模擬機軟體讓機師能在百分之百安全的環境下進行極端側風著陸特訓。

examples.en: Computer fluid dynamic simulations help aerospace engineers design aerodynamic race cars.
examples.zh: 尖端電腦流體力學數位模擬試驗，有力協助頂級航太工程師設計出風阻係數極低且極富下壓力的頂級競賽賽車車體。

examples.en: Doctors practice difficult laparoscopic surgical procedures on computer simulations before operating on real patients.
examples.zh: 年輕住院醫師在正式踏手術台為真實病患執刀之前，必須先在高度逼真的電腦腹腔鏡虛擬模擬器上反覆苦練數百次。

examples.en: AI-powered predictive maintenance detects equipment wear before breakdowns occur.
examples.zh: 結合 AI 人工智慧的預測性維護技術能在工廠機台零件故障前提前發出預警。

examples.en: Predictive analytics algorithms help retail managers forecast holiday shopping demand with remarkable accuracy.
examples.zh: 結合大數據的預測性分析演算法，能協助連鎖零售通路主管以令人驚嘆的精準度提前預估各大連假檔期的備貨需求。

examples.en: Doctors use predictive genetic testing to assess an individual's long-term risk of developing chronic diseases.
examples.zh: 專業醫師善用高科技預測性基因檢測，全方位深入評估個別患者在未來數十年內罹患各類家族遺傳慢性病的高風險機率。

examples.en: Regular elevator maintenance prevents unexpected mechanical failures.
examples.zh: 定期落實專業電梯升降機保養維護能徹底杜絕無預警突發機械運轉故障。

examples.en: High-speed rail tracks undergo rigorous nocturnal maintenance every single night when trains are not running.
examples.zh: 台灣高鐵軌道網絡在每晚末班車收班離場後的深夜時段，皆必須接受工程維修車隊極其苛刻嚴密的夜間鐵道養護保養。

examples.en: Eating a nutrient-rich balanced diet and staying active is vital for long-term health maintenance.
examples.zh: 堅持攝取營養均衡的原型天然食物並常保身心運動活力，對於維繫個人的長期身心健康而言是永遠不可或缺的基石。

words.definition: 系統正常運作時間；妥善運轉率

examples.en: Cloud hosting providers guarantee 99.99% system uptime for global services.
examples.zh: 頂級雲端伺服器託管服務商為全球客戶提供高達 99.99% 的系統超高妥善率保證。

examples.en: Redundant server architecture helped the financial portal maintain flawless 100% uptime during market trading hours.
examples.zh: 具備多重備份的雙活伺服器叢集架構，有力保障了該金融股票交易大盤在開盤交易時段內始終保持百分之百的零中斷完美運行。

examples.en: Even thirty seconds of unexpected server downtime can cost millions of dollars in lost transaction uptime.
examples.zh: 在瞬息萬變的高頻跨國金融交易中，哪怕只是三十秒的伺服器突發當機中斷，都將造成難以挽回的數百萬美元鉅額交易損失。

words.definition: 停機時間；系統當機中斷期；休息

examples.en: Scheduled database maintenance was performed late at night to minimize downtime.
examples.zh: 核心資料庫例行性維護排定於深夜離峰時段進行以將停機時間降至最低。

examples.en: The unexpected power failure caused four hours of expensive factory downtime.
examples.zh: 突如其來的外電斷電意外事故，直接造成整座自動化晶圓廠長達四個小時、損失以數億元計的昂貴停機中斷。

examples.en: Taking scheduled downtime on weekends allows busy corporate professionals to recharge mental energy.
examples.zh: 在忙碌緊繃的週間工作之餘，懂得在週末給自己排定完全遠離電子信箱的放空休整期，能讓職場菁英迅速滿血復活。

words.definition: 疑難排解；排除故障問題

examples.en: IT engineers worked overnight to troubleshoot the network firewall error.
examples.zh: 資訊工程師通宵達旦值班以迅速排解修復企業網路防火牆所回報的異常錯誤。

examples.en: When the smart TV failed to connect to the home Wi-Fi, he followed the online manual to troubleshoot the issue.
examples.zh: 當客廳的智慧型電視突發無法連上家中 Wi-Fi 無線網路時，他耐著性子對照官方線上說明手冊逐一步驟排查解決問題。

examples.en: Experienced auto mechanics can troubleshoot mysterious engine noises in just a few minutes.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的資深老黑手汽車維修技師，往往只需側耳傾聽幾分鐘，即可精準揪出並排除引擎室內部傳來的古怪異響。

words.definition: 容錯能力；系統容錯機制

examples.en: High fault tolerance ensures the banking server keeps running even if one node fails.
examples.zh: 高度完善的容錯機制確保了銀行伺服器叢集即使單一節點損壞仍能持續穩健運作。

examples.en: Space probes heading to outer solar system destinations are engineered with exceptional hardware fault tolerance.
examples.zh: 遠征太陽系外圍深空的天文深空探測器，其機載核心硬體電路在設計之初便具備超乎尋常的極致容錯容災冗餘能力。

examples.en: Implementing distributed database clusters provides superior fault tolerance against localized hardware crashes.
examples.zh: 在企業內部全面部署現代化分散式資料庫叢集架構，能為核心業務提供抵抗單一伺服器突發硬體故障的絕佳容錯能力。

words.definition: 備援機制；多重備份；冗餘設計

examples.en: Dual fiber optic lines provide vital network redundancy against undersea cable cuts.
examples.zh: 雙迴路光纖網絡提供了關鍵的備援機制，能有效防範海底電纜意外中斷危機。

examples.en: Modern passenger aircraft are designed with triple hydraulic control redundancy to guarantee flight safety.
examples.zh: 現代民航大型噴射客機在方向舵控制系統上全面配備了三套相互獨立的液壓控制備援系統，以確保極限飛行安全萬無一失。

examples.en: The merger between the two competing software firms unfortunately led to widespread job redundancies.
examples.zh: 兩家同業競爭的軟體巨頭在宣布強強合併之後，不可避免地在總部行政與重複的業務職能部門中引發了大規模的職位裁撤精簡。

examples.en: Edge computing processes camera sensor data locally without latency delays.
examples.zh: 邊緣運算能在地端設備端直接秒速處理影像感測數據，無需回傳雲端無延遲。

examples.en: In autonomous vehicles, edge computing microchips make millisecond braking decisions without relying on cloud connections.
examples.zh: 在自動駕駛汽車的核心運算單元中，邊緣運算晶片能夠在毫秒之內自主做出緊急制動煞車決策，完全無須依賴外界雲端網路連線。

examples.en: Smart factories deploy edge computing nodes alongside manufacturing robots to detect defective parts in real time.
examples.zh: 現代化智慧工業無人工廠在組裝機器人手臂身側廣泛部署了邊緣運算模組，能在生產線上毫無延遲地即時揪出外觀瑕疵零件。

examples.en: Ultra-low 5G latency enables instantaneous real-time cloud gaming streaming.
examples.zh: 5G 超低延遲傳輸特性讓玩家能享受零卡頓、即時無縫的雲端遊戲極致體驗。

examples.en: Financial traders spend millions laying dedicated fiber cables across oceans to shave microseconds off network latency.
examples.zh: 華爾街頂級高頻量化交易機構豪擲數千萬美元在各大洲海底鋪設專屬直連光纜，只為在跨國網路數據延遲中搶下幾微秒先機。

examples.en: High audio latency can make conducting musical rehearsals over online video conference software very frustrating.
examples.zh: 過高的音訊訊號延遲往往會讓樂團成員透過線上視訊會議軟體進行遠端合奏排練時，感到節拍完全無法對齊的極大挫折。

words.definition: 光纖寬頻；高速寬頻網路

examples.en: Gigabit fiber optic broadband delivers blazing-fast 4K video downloads.
examples.zh: Gb 級極速光纖寬頻網路為全家提供順暢無比的 4K 超高畫質影音即時下載體驗。

examples.en: Government subsidies helped extend high-speed broadband wireless access to remote mountain villages.
examples.zh: 政府偏鄉專案數位通訊補助款的大力挹注，成功將高速光纖寬頻無線網路鋪設延伸至全島最偏僻的高山原鄉部落。

examples.en: Reliable home broadband internet is an absolute necessity for telecommuters working full-time from home.
examples.zh: 穩定且永不斷線的高品質居家寬頻網路，對於全天候在家遠端上班辦公的遠距工作者而言是絕對不可或缺的基本生活必需品。

examples.en: Police and firefighters collaborate closely to uphold public safety.
examples.zh: 警察與消防救護人員緊密協同作業以全心全力捍衛社會公共安全與祥和。

examples.en: Installing bright LED streetlamps in dark alleyways noticeably improved public safety for night commuters.
examples.zh: 在原本幽暗狹窄的市區巷弄全面加裝高流明節能 LED 路燈，顯著提升了夜歸女性與通勤市民的夜間公共安全感。

examples.en: Stringent building codes regarding earthquake resistance are enacted strictly to preserve public safety.
examples.zh: 政府主管機關頒布並嚴格貫徹建築物高耐震係數法規標準，其唯一的終極目的就是為了誓死守護全體國民的公共生命安全。

examples.en: The 119 emergency center dispatched three ambulances to the highway accident.
examples.zh: 119 緊急勤務救災指揮中心立即緊急調派三輛救護車趕赴高速公路事故現場。

examples.en: The courier company will dispatch your order immediately from the northern logistics warehouse.
examples.zh: 物流快遞公司將在收到您的付款憑單後第一時間，直接自北部智慧物流總倉將商品火速出貨派遣發送。

examples.en: Foreign correspondents were dispatched to the border region to report on the emerging refugee crisis.
examples.zh: 國際知名通訊社資深戰地特派記者被火速派遣趕赴邊界前線，就正在急劇升溫發酵的國際人道難民危機展開第一手報導。

words.definition: 民防整備；民防防護體系

examples.en: Community volunteers participate in civil defense and disaster response drills.
examples.zh: 社區熱心里民志工積極踴躍參與民防整備與災害應變搜救實兵演練。

examples.en: Maintaining stockpile emergency rations and basic medical supplies is a key component of civilian civil defense.
examples.zh: 平時在居家儲備充足的應急口糧、瓶裝水與急救止血醫藥包，是落實基層民間民防安全整備最核心的一環。

examples.en: The national civil defense agency educates citizens on how to locate designated shelters during emergencies.
examples.zh: 國家民防防救主管機關印發文宣手冊，普及教育全體國民如何在突發天災或緊急事態降臨時，第一時間精準尋獲周遭防空避難處所。

examples.en: Designated underground metro stations serve as safe air-raid shelters.
examples.zh: 市區各大指定地下捷運站體皆具備堅固完善的防空避難處所掩體功能。

examples.en: The kindhearted couple adopted a stray golden retriever puppy from the municipal animal shelter.
examples.zh: 這對心地善良的年輕夫婦專程造訪公立公有動物收容所，收養了一隻無家可歸的流浪黃金獵犬幼犬。

examples.en: Hikers trapped on the ridge by the sudden blizzard were lucky to find a rustic stone mountain shelter.
examples.zh: 在高山稜線上被突如其來的狂暴暴風雪死死困住的登山小隊，萬分慶幸在山凹處尋獲了一處古樸堅固的避難砌石山屋。

words.definition: 具韌性的；適應力強的；能迅速復原的

examples.en: Building resilient urban infrastructure helps cities withstand extreme climate events.
examples.zh: 打造具備高度韌性的都市基礎建設能讓現代城市抵禦極端氣候天災的嚴峻衝擊。

examples.en: The resilient young entrepreneur dusted herself off after business failure and founded another successful startup.
examples.zh: 這位堅韌不拔的年輕創業家在經歷了前一次事業慘澹收場的挫敗後毫不氣餒，重整旗鼓再次打造出另一家極其成功的新創公司。

examples.en: Developing a flexible, resilient mindset enables individuals to navigate unpredictable life transitions with grace.
examples.zh: 在內心深處修煉出一種兼具彈性與韌性的強大心理韌性，能讓人在面對充滿未知動盪的人生轉折時始終從容優雅、處變不驚。

examples.en: Taiwan continues to advance as a globally competitive high-tech smart nation.
examples.zh: 台灣持續昂首闊步邁進，化身為具備全球頂尖競爭力的高科技智慧國家。

examples.en: Becoming a smart nation requires bridging the digital divide so seniors can access public services effortlessly.
examples.zh: 邁向智慧國家發展藍圖的關鍵核心，在於全面弭平城鄉數位落差，讓銀髮長輩也能零門檻輕鬆享受數位公共服務的極致便利。

examples.en: Investments in AI semiconductors and green computing form the strategic cornerstone of our smart nation blueprint.
examples.zh: 在人工智慧先進半導體製程與綠色低碳運算基礎設施上的持續龐大投資，構成了我們智慧國家戰略藍圖中最不可動搖的基石。

examples.en: Reaching 3,000 English vocabulary words is a tremendous learning milestone!
examples.zh: 成功累積掌握三千個實用英語單字是一項無比值得自豪的重大學習里程碑！

examples.en: Successfully launching our first commercial orbital rocket was a historic engineering milestone for the team.
examples.zh: 成功將我們團隊自主研發的第一枚商業入軌運載火箭送入浩瀚太空軌道，是全體工程研發團隊載入史冊的輝煌工程里程碑。

examples.en: Graduating from university marked an unforgettable milestone in his journey toward adulthood and independence.
examples.zh: 身著學士袍昂首從大學畢業，標誌著他邁向成熟獨立成人世界的征途中一個令人終生難忘的嶄新里程碑。
